clue.text: Despotic Italian rat to broadcast

indicators.note: to broadcast is to scatter widely, so these letters are spread about and rearranged

explanation.surface: An Italian informer is about to spread news for a tyrant.
explanation.definitionFit: A despotic regime exercises total, absolute control over its citizens, which is what totalitarian rule means.

clue.text: They conduct examinations of graduates, tersely

clue.text: Oil from car, until changed, black inside

changed says the letters are altered into a new order

explanation.walkthrough: 'changed' turns CARUNTIL into LURICANT; 'inside' puts B within it.
explanation.definitionFit: A lubricant is any substance such as oil used to reduce friction.

clue.text: Confine water source, restricting river

clue.text: Give in, accepting affair's suggestive

explanation.definitionFit: Redolent of something means reminiscent or evocative, so suggestive of it.

clue.text: Tenor in vocal solo entrances

parts.note: an aria is a solo song in opera

explanation.definitionFit: Atria are entrance halls, the plural of atrium in Roman houses.

clue.text: Whims to produce silver in metamorphoses

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: something that metamorphoses changes, so it varies

clue.text: Pale while having sex

indicators.note: having means holding, so one piece contains the other

parts.note: while means at the time when

clue.text: On the right bearing, sailor turned off reportedly

explanation.walkthrough: 'reportedly' turns BORED into its sound-alike BOARD.
explanation.definitionFit: Nautical term: the right-hand side of a ship, looking forward, is the side on the right.

clue.text: Get to every single redhead first

parts.note: the head of the word red is its first letter, R

explanation.surface: Reaching every last ginger-haired person ahead of the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: To reach a place is to get to it; the two verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Food for city animal's den

parts.note: EC is the postcode area of the City of London
a wild animal's den is its lair

explanation.definitionFit: An eclair is a cream-filled choux pastry, a specific example of food.

clue.text: Charming provincial embracing London leader

parts.note: a provincial, someone from the country, may be called a peasant

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its opening letter

explanation.definitionFit: Charming and pleasant are synonyms describing someone agreeable company.

clue.text: Underground vehicle taken back with awful Yank initially

indicators.note: initially picks the opening letter of each of the following words

clue.text: Beam end coming down hitting head

indicators.note: end here is the front end of the word, its opening letter

parts.note: rain coming down means it is raining

explanation.surface: A falling beam crashes onto someone in a downpour.

clue.text: Sluggishness at work?

definitions.meaning: a lack of activity or movement
busy and operating, read as a two-word phrase

explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer into two words for the second sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Inaction is the state of doing nothing, which is what sluggishness amounts to.

clue.text: Get in after fish and chips

explanation.walkthrough: 'Man' is the Isle of Man, the island in the Irish Sea, not a person; 'almost' cuts ISLE to ISL.

clue.text: A strike revolt over in slaughterhouse

parts.note: a riot is a violent revolt

clue.text: Habit's a passion needing to keep sober

clue.text: Letter I posted including reply

indicators.note: including says the letters are held within the words

indicators.note: turned over says the hidden letters are read backwards
in says the letters sit inside the words that follow

clue.text: Cribs enabling to comprehend foreign author

gone from says these two letters leave the following word

clue.text: Old container circling English main

parts.note: a can is a container

clue.text: Bounce backside on piano

clue.text: Ladders containing last of big steps

explanation.definitionFit: Rungs are the steps or crossbars of a ladder.

clue.text: Brave daughter missing some female relatives?

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for daughter in family trees
without one's aunts, so having no aunts, aunt-less

explanation.definitionFit: Dauntless means fearless, never daunted, a synonym for brave.

clue.text: Excess remnant with piece in shreds

explanation.surface: Too much leftover cloth and a fragment torn to bits.
